drafts.subject: Re: Guest post on jaseci.org
drafts.message:
Hi Jessica,

Thank you for reaching out and expressing interest in contributing to jaseci.org. We appreciate your offer of $150 per published post with a dofollow link.

We would be delighted to consider a guest post from Content Boost Agency. Our standard rate for guest posts with one dofollow link is $200. If you're comfortable with our rate, please let us know, and we can proceed with discussing the guidelines and topics of interest.

We are also keen on establishing a long-term partnership and would love to explore any additional collaboration opportunities.

Looking forward to your thoughts.

Best regards,
[Your Full Name]
[Your Position]
Jaseci.org
